player_card.title: Tabula — Hold the Gate
player_card.situation: Tiered plateau. The mid gate is the only clean climb. Armada watches the ramps; Null mercs skirmish the lower shelf.
player_card.objective_text: Take and hold the mid plateau gate until the mark completes.
player_card.how_to_win: Maneuver, do not slug. Probe ramps, flank the gate, hold the mark. Soft clock ~12 min.
player_card.threats: Elevated guns. Frontal climb is expensive. Routes exist left and right.
player_card.allies: Thin Null merc screen on the lower shelf.

briefing_lines.speaker: ketha
briefing_lines.text: Don't charge the stairs. Own the angle, then the gate.

briefing_lines.speaker: vane
briefing_lines.text: Plateau fights reward patience. Then they reward violence.

player_card.title: Tabula — Expand the Shelf
player_card.situation: Gate is yours. Now plant metal and energy on the north shelf. This is the first real expand — constructors matter.
player_card.objective_text: Grow eco on the north shelf and hold it against the counter.
player_card.how_to_win: Build mex and energy. Keep a front. When income is fat enough and the shelf is held, extract. Soft clock ~14 min.
player_card.threats: Armada probes. If you pure-raid without eco, the clock eats you.
player_card.allies: None on shelf. You are the main effort.

briefing_lines.speaker: ketha
briefing_lines.text: Plant something that pays. Then defend the plant.

briefing_lines.speaker: vane
briefing_lines.text: Wind and solars first if the plateau is hungry.

player_card.title: Greenest Fields — Converter Crawl
player_card.situation: No metal on the green — only converters. Race Armada on energy-to-metal. Build wind/solar, feed converters, starve theirs.
player_card.objective_text: Out-eco Armada on the converter grid and wreck their farm.
player_card.how_to_win: Energy first, then conversion. Raid their eco once yours is stable. Soft clock ~12 min.
player_card.threats: Armada converter farm + light perimeter. No mex for anyone.

briefing_lines.speaker: ketha
briefing_lines.text: Metal is a lie here. Energy is the truth.

briefing_lines.speaker: vane
briefing_lines.text: If our converters stall, we are just infantry in a field.

player_card.title: Koom — Tempo Lane
player_card.situation: Fluid scar again — but this time you bring expand power. Own the tempo lane so the next siege has metal behind it.
player_card.objective_text: Seize and hold the tempo lane; keep eco breathing.
player_card.how_to_win: Push when fat, hold when thin. Mix expand with pressure. Extract when held.
player_card.threats: Fortified works mid-valley. Residual Armada + Null merc traffic.

briefing_lines.speaker: ketha
briefing_lines.text: Tempo is a lane you stand on, not a speech.

player_card.title: Glass — Deeper Pocket
player_card.situation: Second pass under the Eye. Deeper pocket, meaner garrison. You may bring a thin eco toehold on the rim — still a strike, not a city.
player_card.objective_text: Kill the secondary Cortex node. Heroes live. Extract.
player_card.how_to_win: Flank the glass. Optional rim energy only. Do not dig a fortress. Soft clock ~12 min.
player_card.threats: Fortified pocket + Armada overwatch. Frontal is still a grinder.
player_card.allies: Null merc foothold thinned since last glass run.

briefing_lines.speaker: ketha
briefing_lines.text: Same glass. Deeper teeth. Flank or die.
